svg.title: Ancient Tailed Demon — Rites of the Sealed. Draft 3 / Ancient Tailed Demon classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Demon's Grasp forks into Rending Bellow then Howl of Annihilation, or Festering Brand then Consuming Malice. Demon's Marrow forks into Scarred Hide then Unyielding Husk, or Boiling Ichor then Primordial Rampage. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Ancient Tailed Demon jutsu (bloodline-keyed classification, proposed extension).

Rampage"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Node split: the two roots follow the two support casts. Demon's Grasp raises both Demonic Embrace rows and forks into Rending Bellow \u2192 Howl of Annihilation (Roar damage) and Festering Brand \u2192 Consuming Malice (Afterburn). Demon's Marrow raises both Demonic Vitae rows and forks into Scarred Hide \u2192 Unyielding Husk (DDT) and Boiling Ichor \u2192 Primordial Rampage (IDG). 2/4/4; every capstone is 3 BP deep; two capstones cost 5 (shared root) or 6 BP. No node is in every legal 4-BP build.","Reference reuse: topology and most flats follow Taiyo Kami nearly verbatim (Foundations +2/+2, Festering Brand and Scarred Hide = Emberwake and Golden Mantle +3, Husk close to Sovereign Sun). Departures: each Foundation carries one support cast's row pair; Rending Bellow is +3, not +2 (Damage reaches one row, not three); Malice is +5 AB/+3 IDT, not +7/+3/+3 (Grasp already adds AB +2; Embrace has no IDG); the DDG route becomes IDG (no DDG row). The shape fits two support casts plus one strike.","Flats: every tag reaches one ungated row and the four routes sit on four tags, so route maxima sit at the single-row guardrails: Damage +6 (45\u219251 on one 60 AP area hit), Afterburn, DDT and IDG +10. Vitae capstones (08, 10) carry +5 primary and a +2 secondary below the sibling Hidden Art's +3, so hybrids like 01,06,07,09 stay non-dominated. IDT shares Embrace with Afterburn and adds to the same hits, so it has no route: Foundation +2 plus Howl +2 or Malice +3, max +5. Row weight 19 (Taiyo 31).","Interaction with the kit: every row is element-less and lists all four stat types (Vitae IDG also Highest), so each already matches every non-pierce hit (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73: stat filters on element-less rows are not binding); the nodes raise percentages, not reach. Kit rows add power/100 \u00d7 staged base (\u00a73b); only the bloodline IDG passive (20% + 0.15/lvl) multiplies, on top. Its 5% IDT passive is a standing self-weakness the Vitae routes partly offset (DDT +2 to +10).","Delivery and timing: all three jutsu have cooldown 7. Vitae (SELF, 40 AP) gives 3 rounds of IDG but only 2 of DDT; Embrace (one target, range 4, 40 AP) 2 rounds. Rows act only in the rounds after their cast round (\u00a73b), so Vitae and Embrace (80 AP together) go a round before Roar to touch it. Roar (AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN, range 4, 60 AP) is the only damage: damage row friendly fire ENEMIES, unsupported Wound row friendly fire none (ally hazard, no node touches it).","Fourth purchase: normally the other Foundation (the four examples) or a sibling Hidden Art (01,02,03,04 Afterburn 40%; 01,02,04,05 Roar 48; 06,07,08,09 and 06,07,09,10 all-Vitae). All 14 legal full builds are non-dominated (arithmetic only). Value options (user-owned, unchanged): IDG +10 and Damage +6 sit at the guardrails, fallbacks +8 (Ichor 3/Rampage 3) and +5 (Bellow 2/Howl 3); Howl IDT +3 (build IDT +5, within the ceiling) would lift the Roar burst build."],"risks":["Classification: no element isolates this kit (every row is element-less). The tree requires the bloodline-keyed classification extension; under the current resolver a modifier would need affectedElements including None, which reaches every non-elemental row on any jutsu the player casts. Whether NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT jutsu could collide is unverified (no non-bloodline catalog in the repository).","Afterburn at 45% on the pressure route: in the 2 rounds after the cast it adds floor(hit \u00d7 45%) to every non-pierce hit the target takes from any source; Afterburn sources add, capped at 60% of each hit, so it saturates when another source (main tree, items, allies) is also on the target. Value scales with hits landed in the window, not with the one application row; not simulated.","Leakage: Demonic Embrace's IDT debuff adds to every non-pierce hit the target takes from the caster and allies, normal jutsu, weapons and basics included; Demonic Vitae's IDG self buff raises every non-pierce hit the caster alone lands. Both rows are element-less: potency widens the number, not the scope. Same-tag effects from allies, the main tree or recasts apply and add (process.ts 1109\u20131117).","Pierce: IDG, IDT and DDT do not modify pierce hits and Afterburn skips them, so the whole tree is blind to pierce damage. Only Rending Bellow / Howl of Annihilation (raw Roar power) is unaffected by that.","Weakest route (user-owned value call): the Roar burst example (01,02,03,06) is the likely weakest of the four: route row weight 12 against 14\u201315, full build 16 against 18\u201319, and its primary lands on one 60 AP cast per 7 rounds while the other routes ride 2\u20133-round windows over every non-pierce hit. The reversible lift (Howl IDT +3) is in design notes; values are unchanged.","Ally hazard: Ancient Demon Roar's Wound row (35%, friendly fire none) lands on allies inside the circle; the caster is never a target of an OTHER_USER area jutsu (\u00a74b). No node touches it, but the Roar route invites more Roar casts. No supported row is an area hazard; Embrace aimed at an ally (OTHER_USER permits it, \u00a73b) would land both raised debuffs on that ally.","Ranked modes: skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING at the pin (combat.ts 3053\u20133078), so no node does anything there.","No combat simulation. Non-dominance is arithmetic on per-tag flats; main-tree effects, equipment, AP economy, actual hit counts in the Embrace window and the bloodline's 5% damage-taken passive were not modelled. Percentage caps are not approached (highest value 45%)."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":14,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":10,"increasedamagetaken":5,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"afterburn":10},"supported_rows_in_kit":5,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"afterburn":1,"damage":1,"decreasedamagetaken":1,"increasedamagegiven":1,"increasedamagetaken":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["afterburn","damage","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 3 / Ancient Tailed Demon classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Ancient Tailed Demon jutsu inherit Ancient Tailed Demon potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."]},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","02","03","04"],"bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagetaken":4,"afterburn":5}},{"ids":["01","02","03","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":4,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"afterburn":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","05"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagetaken":5,"afterburn":10}},{"ids":["01","02","04","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"afterburn":5}},{"ids":["01","02","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":5,"afterburn":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"afterburn":2}},{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":5,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"afterburn":10}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":5,"afterburn":5}},{"ids":["01","04","06","09"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"afterburn":5}},{"ids":["01","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":4,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"afterburn":2}},{"ids":["01","06","07","09"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":5,"afterburn":2}},{"ids":["01","06","09","10"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":10,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":4,"afterburn":2}},{"ids":["06","07","08","09"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":7,"decreasedamagetaken":10}},{"ids":["06","07","09","10"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":10,"decreasedamagetaken":7}}]}

g.text: Draft 3 / Ancient Tailed Demon classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
ANCIENT TAILED DEMON CLASSIFICATION · BLOODLINE-KEYED (PROPOSED EXTENSION)
Every Ancient Tailed Demon jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Howl of Annihilation path + Demon's Marrow
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn
FINAL ANCIENT TAILED DEMON TAG VALUES
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
